d:
The best saves from Week 5 of the 2026-27 NHL season are here, featuring impossible paddle stops, acrobatic robberies and some spectacular old-school goaltending.
Mackenzie Blackwood puts together a highlight-reel week, flashing the glove to rob Matt Coronato on a point-blank 2-on-1 before holding the post with a huge toe save on Connor Bedard. Adin Hill also makes multiple spectacular appearances, somehow keeping Tim Stützle out with a desperation arm save before breaking out an acrobatic two-pad stack to deny Jack Hughes.
